text: Minor degree requirement profile for Sustainability Minor Undergraduate Program (SUST-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2023-2024 (202301). Total minimum SU credits: 18. Total minimum ECTS: None. Sections: required courses (3 SU, 1 courses in pool), core electives (9 SU, 19 courses in pool), area electives (6 SU, 19 courses in pool). Diploma area advisors: Nuri Zafer Yenal.

The required courses pool for the Sustainability Minor Undergraduate Program (SUST-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2023-2024 (202301) contains 1 courses; minimum 3 SU credits required; minimum 1 courses required. Courses: MGMT 301 Introduction to Sustainability.

The core electives pool for the Sustainability Minor Undergraduate Program (SUST-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2023-2024 (202301) contains 19 courses; minimum 9 SU credits required; minimum 3 courses required. Courses: BIO 330 Environmental Plant Biology, BIO 363 Ecology, CULT 384 Political Ecology and Society, IF 201 Science, Engineering and Politics of Food, IF 402 Sustainability and Circularity in Materials, IR 489 Human Rights in World Affairs, MGMT 302 Sustainability Assessment Methods and Tools, MGMT 310 Humanitarian Management and Sustainability: Civil Society, Crisis, and the Economies of Aid, MGMT 333 Business Ethics and Social Sustainability, MGMT 410 Corporate Governance and Social Responsibility, MGMT 412 Social Innovation and Entrepreneurship, MGMT 424 Leadership of Sustainability, ORG 405 Human Resources Analytics, PHIL 460 Environmental Ethics and Sustainability, SOC 425 Power, Economy, and Society, SOC 426 Gender and Work, SPS 374 Global Environmental Challenges, SPS 394 Political Ecology and Society, SPS 404 Six Key Global Challenges: A Historical Perspective. Minimum of 3 courses (9 SU credits) must be completed. Students are required to take at least one course from the 2 categories described below. Category 1: Courses with codes IF, BIO, SPS are in Category 1. Category 2: Courses with codes MGMT, ORG, SOC, CULT, IR are in Category 2. Each additional core elective course taken (after completing the core elective degree requirements) may count as an area elective.
